mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.category_id, c.name AS category_name, s.icon, s.description, s.usage_guide, s.model_id, m.model_name, s.kb_id, s.system_prompt, s.user_prompt_tpl, s.input_variables, s.max_tokens, s.temperature, s.multi_turn, s.status, s.created_time, s.updated_time FROM ai_scene s LEFT JOIN ai_scene_category c ON s.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ai_model_config m ON s.model_id = m.id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_scene WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_scene (name, category_id, icon, description, usage_guide, model_id, kb_id, system_prompt, user_prompt_tpl, input_variables, max_tokens, temperature, multi_turn, status, deleted, creator_id, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{icon}, #{description}, #{usageGuide}, #{modelId}, #{kbId}, #{systemPrompt}, #{userPromptTpl}, #{inputVariables}, #{maxTokens}, #{temperature}, #{multiTurn}, 'DRAFT', 0, #{creatorId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_scene SET deleted = 1, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
